captures_problem_valid.name: captures_problem_valid
captures_problem_valid.value: "captures"."problem" is null or length("captures"."problem") between 1 and 200

invoice_rules_icon_valid.name: invoice_rules_icon_valid
invoice_rules_icon_valid.value: "invoice_rules"."icon" is null or (length("invoice_rules"."icon") between 1 and 64 and "invoice_rules"."icon" !~ '[^a-z0-9-]')

line_mappings_target.name: line_mappings_target
line_mappings_target.value: ("line_mappings"."kind" = 'account' and "line_mappings"."account_code" is not null) or ("line_mappings"."kind" <> 'account' and "line_mappings"."item_code" is not null)

line_mappings_price.name: line_mappings_price
line_mappings_price.value: "line_mappings"."kind" not in ('price_alias', 'saved') or "line_mappings"."unit_amount_cents" is not null

review_items_closed_has_resolution.name: review_items_closed_has_resolution
review_items_closed_has_resolution.value: "review_items"."state" = 'open' or ("review_items"."resolution" is not null and "review_items"."resolved_by" is not null and "review_items"."resolved_at" is not null)
